integrity: Self-contained proof and standalone finite checker; finite checks are not a substitute for the all-n proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to finite chain semilattices in the binary meet signature, not to all semilattices. One-sided compatible-ordering structure was previously known from Chajda, Nieminen and Zelinka (1983). Equivalent full-relation enumerations in unindexed literature remain possible. No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
title: Two independent threshold systems for diagonal subsemigroups of chain semilattices
